scope: Single-recording, source-bound circular-phase rank method control; neither xDF nor TTS nor original-paper or population replication. No forced effect, significance reversal, neural or causal claim.

source.frame_indices: all original integer frames0..175, no censoring/trimming/imputation
source.label_rule: Use original atlas fourth-axis row; strip surrounding whitespace from released name/net name fields as the pinned Nilearn loader does. No fuzzy aliases.
source.clock_interpretation: Header declares2seconds, toffset0; exact documentarySubject10064 maps to fixed released0010064 and NYU whose site table agreesTR2. Operational origin0 is relative original-frame indexing, not independently established scanner/slice-time origin.
source_preconditions: Authenticate all10 original/provenance bytes before parsing.
BOLD and confounds retain176frames/rows; all original scientific arrays and selected13confounds finite.
Preserve full39 overlapping maps and source affine/scaling/units. The atlas units are unspecified; world-coordinate affine resampling does not establish nonlinear template correspondence.
Original BOLD has NIfTI extension data and vox_offset6464; do not assume352 or discard bytes. Effective scaling1/0 despite raw slope0; atlasoffset352/effective1/0.

spatial_extraction.dtype: float64 for scaled BOLD/maps, resampling, least squares and cleaning
spatial_extraction.grid: original BOLD spatial grid; no resampling of BOLD
spatial_extraction.transform: If source and target affines are exactly equal and spatial shapes match, copy atlas directly. Otherwise atlas-voxel coordinates = scipy.linalg.inv(atlas affine) @ BOLD affine; use identity transform when affines equal but shapes differ.
spatial_extraction.interpolation: scipy.ndimage.affine_transform order1, mode=constant,cval=0,prefilter=False. Use three diagonal entries as a vector if spatial transform exactly diagonal; otherwise full3x3 matrix. Same disclosed SciPy primitive may be shared by oracle and grader.
spatial_extraction.clip: clip all resampled maps to [min(0,global original atlas minimum), max(0,global original atlas maximum)]; retain negative weights
spatial_extraction.spatial_order: C-flat voxel order; every BOLD voxel participates, including zero map rows
spatial_extraction.model: M[V,39] @ B[39,176] = Y[V,176]; raw_coefficients=B.T, jointly estimated full39 components, not weighted means or a two-map-only fit

solver.independent_route: Explicit gesvd pseudoinverse, retain singular values s>eps64*smax
solver.rank_policy: Report actual rank, retain all39 columns; no expected rank minimum, dropped maps or substitute targets

temporal_cleaning.detrend_arithmetic: Demean each coefficient and each selected confound; center frame-index linear trend and divide by its Euclidean norm; subtract projection onto that trend before filtering.

filter.application: sosfiltfilt along time, to coefficients and all13confounds before nuisance regression

temporal_cleaning.nuisance: Center each filtered confound, divide by populationSD(ddof0), divisor1 ifSD<eps64. scipy.linalg.qr(mode=economic,pivoting=True); retain Q columns where abs(diag(R))>100*eps64. residual = filtered_coefficients - (Q@Q.T)@filtered_coefficients. Association explicitly follows pinned Nilearn0.13.1; no hidden alternate projection order.
temporal_cleaning.final_standardization: Recenter residuals; for each canonically active component divide by sampleSD(ddof1), divisor1 only ifSD<eps64. Canonically inactive components have zero final series. Then select original map6 and32, without sign changes.
temporal_cleaning.additional_processing: None: no GSR, censoring, interpolation, extra nuisance columns or final second population standardization.
temporal_cleaning.amendment: Explicit float64/full-map numerical recipe and pre-zscore guard replace implicit legacy dtype/support behavior; not claimed bitwise equivalent to the historical oracle.

support_and_fidelity.scaled_centering: For finite vector v, exact constants center to literal zeros. Otherwise s=max(abs(v)), u=v/s, c=u-math.fsum(u)/N. Stable centered norm in original units is s*stable_L2(c); stable_L2 uses max-absolute scaling and accurately summed squared terms.
support_and_fidelity.canonical_active_rule: For each target before zscoring: stable_centered_norm(recentered unstandardized residual) > 1e-12*sqrt(N)*max(1,raw_sample_sd). Source reconstruction defines activity; no recomputation from rounded submitted series replaces it.
support_and_fidelity.inactive: Keep all176 frames and raw39 coefficients. Final inactive component is zero in canonical source reconstruction; accepted within-tolerance serialization cannot reactivate inference. If either target inactive, the complete paired inference is undefined with null fields.
support_and_fidelity.active_fidelity: Using common positive prescale for submitted/canonical pair, centered difference norm<=1e-6*canonical centered norm, without absolute floor. Check each canonically active target.
support_and_fidelity.raw_receipt_authority: Raw39 receipts are source evidence, not re-cleaned after rounding to define acceptance.

circular.definition: roll(x,k)[t]=x[(t-k)modN], against unchanged y; all k1..N-1 exactly once, retaining periodic duplicates and sign ties
circular.arithmetic: Apply scaled_centering once separately to each accepted final vector. Use a common positive product of stable centered L2 norms for r0 and every rk. Dot_k=math.fsum(centered_x[(t-k)%N]*centered_y[t]). Count abs(Dot_k)>=abs(Dot_0), without tieepsilon and before rounded correlation receipts.
circular.significant: strict20*(1+n_exceedances)<N; serialized rounded p does not determine verdict
circular.roundoff_domain: Clip computed r to[-1,1] only for excursions<=1e-12; reject larger numerical excursions. Clipping never changes dot-product rank comparison.
circular.undefined: statusinactive_target when either target inactive; r,p_value,significant,null_r entries,exceeds entries,n_exceedances,numerator allnull; retain N,denominatorN,allN-1shift IDs and inactive component labels.
circular.interpretation: Exhaustive circular-phase rank removes Monte Carlo uncertainty only. Stationarity alone does not ensure calibrated type-I-error control; wraparound can distort the null. Significant is the declared rank threshold, not proof of coupling; non-significant is not proof of absence.
circular.optional_sensitivities: Clearly labeled optional analyses only; no maximum-p selection or replacement of required circular evidence.

verification.own_primitive_replay: After sourcefidelity succeeds, replay all inference from accepted finalCSVseries with canonical activity. Do not compare ownrank/count/p/verdict to a second hidden sourcecanonical outcome.
verification.ordering: Keyed CSV rows, NPZ frame/map axes and shift records may reorder coherently; no duplicate or missing keys. Metadatamap/support/source lists may reorder by their explicit IDs.
verification.extras: Harmless finite extra fields/arrays within limits allowed; no object arrays/pickle or duplicate JSONkeys. Software/prose fingerprints are not acceptance gates.
verification.failure: failed_precondition is not completedanalysis; failure_report.json lexists invalidates output evenifempty/dangling. Keep partialevidence, exclusivefresh output/private destinations.
verification.independence_limit: Separate gelsd/gesvdcomposition and own-source replay share NumPy/SciPy/nibabel primitives; they do not establish completely independent interpolation/software or biological validity.
